requirements.reason: ADR-0002 section 7 defines KS_CMD and KS_RES and says nothing about the identity that creates them, while ADR-0004 section 4 denies administrative JetStream API to every Keystone identity -- so no principal this generator produces can provision a stream. The contract's provisioner is a test fixture minted outside the frozen matrix, which is why GEN-3 does not see it. C06 owns the production stream configuration and is where that identity has to be decided and authorized
